sup:70410.subject: Mechanical seal 24 mm (part:340010): binding full-volume commitment from 2027
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We understand your capacity situation. You have said you prioritise firm, long-term commitments, and we are prepared to give one. In return, we need full allocation of 23,400 pcs/year and a lower price.

We propose two complete packages. Both are DAP, with payment at 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling:

A: 23,400 pcs/year, 24-month binding commitment, 42 days lead time, EUR 25.76/unit.
B: 23,400 pcs/year, 36-month binding commitment, 56 days lead time, EUR 25.04/unit.

Our orders for this seal on 2026-09-07 and 2026-09-21 were both at EUR 29.89/unit (po:4500014383-10, po:4500014436-10).

Your supplier-wide on-time delivery in scorecard sc:70410@2026Q3 was 79.5%, and we ask that the price for a reliable full allocation reflect the service actually delivered.

Our own bottom-up estimate (cost:340010) puts this seal at EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty. This is our estimate, not a statement of your actual costs.

Which package can you support, and what adjustment would make it work for you?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

sup:70410.subject: Re: Mechanical seal 24 mm (part:340010): binding full-volume commitment from 2027
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the delivery record data, the price history data, and the should cost data you cited. The data holds, and the should cost data was taken into account, but this does not change our calculation. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We accept your proposal for a 36-month commitment and a volume of 23,400 pieces per year with a 56-day lead time. We offer EUR 32.00 per unit for this package, reflecting the extended contract term and lead time.

Which volume can you commit to?

Our offer comprises a price of €32.00 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 7 days. This is our letztes Angebot. Please decide.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.
